1.w: The book of the genealogy of Jesus Christ, son of David, son of Abraham:

2.w: Abraham begat Isaac, and Isaac begat Jacob, and Jacob begat Judah and his brothers.

3.w: And Judah begat Perez and Zerah out of Tamar, and Perez begat Hezron, and Hezron begat Aram.

4.w: And Aram begat Amminadab, and Amminadab begat Nahshon, and Nahshon begat Salmon.

5.w: And Salmon begat Boaz out of Rahab, and Boaz begat Obed out of Ruth, and Obed begat Jesse,

6.w: and Jesse begat David the king. And: David begat Solomon out of her who [was] of Uriah,

7.w: and Solomon begat Rehoboam, and Rehoboam begat Abijah, and Abijah begat Asaph.

8.w: And Asaph begat Jehoshaphat, and Jehoshaphat begat Joram, and Joram begat Uzziah.

9.w: And Uzziah begat Jotham, and Jotham begat Ahaz, and Ahaz begat Hezekiah.

10.w: And Hezekiah begat Manasseh, and Manasseh begat Amos, and Amos begat Josiah,

11.w: and Josiah begat Jeconiah and his brothers at the deportation to Babylon.

12.w: And after the deportation to Babylon: Jeconiah begat Shealtiel, and Shealtiel begat Zerubbabel,

13.w: and Zerubbabel begat Abiud, and Abiud begat Eliakim, and Eliakim begat Azor.

14.w: And Azor begat Zadok, and Zadok begat Achim, and Achim begat Eliud.

15.w: And Eliud begat Eleazar, and Eleazar begat Matthan, and Matthan begat Jacob,

16.w: and Jacob begat Joseph, the husband of Mary, out of whom was begotten Jesus, the One being called Christ.

17.w: Therefore all the generations from Abraham until David [were] fourteen generations, and from David until the deportation to Babylon fourteen generations, and from the deportation to Babylon until the Christ fourteen generations.

18.w: Now the birth of Jesus Christ was thus: His mother Mary, having been betrothed to Joseph, before their coming together was found having in womb from the Holy Spirit.

19.w: And Joseph her husband, being righteous and not willing to make an example of her, resolved to send her away secretly.

20.w: But [on] his having pondered these things, behold, an angel of the Lord appeared to him in a dream, saying, “Joseph son of David, you should not be afraid to receive Mary [as] your wife, for that having been begotten in her is from the Holy Spirit.

21.w: And she will bear a Son, and you will call His name Jesus, for He will save His people from their sins.”

22.w: And all this has come to pass so that it might be fulfilled, that having been spoken by the Lord through the prophet, saying,

23.w: “Behold, the virgin will have in womb, and she will bear a son, and they will call His name Immanuel,” which is, being translated, “God with us.”

24.w: And Joseph, having been awoken from sleep, did as the angel of the Lord commanded him and received his wife.

25.w: And he did not know her until she bore a Son, and he called His name Jesus.
